about: Who speaks for the cutter, in the format of ships/carrier/voices.json. `ai` is the same automated system voice the carrier has (the same saved voice). `ship` is the flight deck's talker: aboard a crew of four that is her commander, so this entry is a stand-in (the carrier's bridge talker's cast) until the calls a small ship makes are given to a person. Her crew are people (content/people/cutter-*.json), each with their own cast. `nets` are the rooms where a department's net is heard without a headset.

ship.label: Flight deck
ship.design: A clear, even-voiced woman in her thirties with a neutral Canadian accent, the trained cadence of a broadcast announcer.
ship.style: Urgent without panic; every word carries down a steel passage.
ship.sample: Now relieve the watch. Blue watch has the first watch.

ai.label: Ship
ai.design: A smooth, level, ageless woman's voice with no regional accent, perfectly even in pitch and pace, without warmth or hurry, like a well-made automated system.
ai.style: A ship's announcer: clear and composed at a natural, brisk speaking pace, human and attentive, never sing-song or robotic.
ai.sample: Fire, fire, fire. Gym and rec. Forward drum, outer deck. Away the damage control party.
